era: www.nih.gov: the 2015-2020 Drupal design (HHS strip, NIH logo, dark-blue gradient nav bar of six items, blue hero panel, brown section headings on a beige page) seen on all 2019 captures. PubMed: legacy NCBI PubMed (www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed) was the default for everyone in 2019; the new PubMed was only a preview (NLM Technical Bulletin 2019 Nov-Dec: 'will become the default in spring 2020'), so PubMed pages are styled as legacy NCBI PubMed, while the controls the current app shares with the 2019 new-PubMed preview are cited from the 2019 bulletin figures.
